attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates OBBBA 2025 deductions: No Tax on Tips, No Tax on Overtime, and Senior Additional Deduction. These are above-the-line deductions that reduce AGI.

initial_action.action_description: set result.tips_deduction = 0, set result.overtime_deduction = 0, set result.senior_deduction = 0
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.tips_deduction xdef 0.0 /result.overtime_deduction xdef 0.0 /result.senior_deduction xdef 0.0 /result.total_obbba_deductions xdef "OBBBA 2025 DEDUCTIONS (One Big Beautiful Bill Act)" job.audit_trail swap addto
